description: Cancel a native video upload you prepared, releasing its provider storage reservation. Exact status "canceled" confirms the release; "canceling" means the release is still pending (retry); "ready" means the asset became immutable first and cannot be canceled. A successful cancel removes the asset and your repeat still returns "canceled" (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id); an unknown id, or someone else’s video, is 404. Convergent — no idempotencyKey.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_video_cancel
